newsitem.title: USA: Bonneville leaves Wed power offers unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Bonneville leaves Wed power offers unchanged.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) left surplus power offers unchanged for Wednesday deliveries, the agency said Tuesday.
BPA still offered 300 megawatts of firm peak power at $11.00 per megawatt hour (MWh) for Northwest sales and $12.00 for California-Oregon border (COB) sales.
BPA also continued to offer power at $7.00 per MWh during hours ending 0100-0600 and 2300-2400 PST to buyers willing to displace thermal generation with hydropower.
Non-firm power during shoulder hours on Wednesday (0700, 1100-1700 and 2100-2200 PST) was unchanged at $9.00 per MWh for Northwest deliveries and $10.00 for COB.
Prices for firm and non-firm power during off-peak hours on Wednesday were unchanged at $9.00 per MWh.
